works.chip: Original fine art architectural photograph for a visual novel gallery, portrait 3:4. Close crop of pale coarse concrete stair landing under warm directional side light. Material grain visible. No people, lettering, frame, watermark. Quiet abstract composition, warm gray ivory, real photography.
